questions.stem: What is the triad of bone cement implantation syndrome?
questions.answer: Hypoxia, hypotension and loss of consciousness

questions.stem: What cardiovascular effects does bone cement implantation syndrome cause?
questions.answer: Hypotension, vasodilation, tachycardia, arrhythmias, cardiac arrest
